description: Free French-learning app for TCF Canada, from your first alphabet lesson to C2 — structured lessons, instant-feedback practice, stories, and friend races.
highlights: 90 topics across CEFR levels A1–C2 (with Canadian CLB equivalents), organised Topic → Subtopic → Concept, with plain-English explanations and every French example translated or glossed.
AI-assisted reading and speaking practice (Groq Whisper + feedback models, server-side), with server-side grading on every answer.
Practice that grades the moment you tap — multiple choice, word order, dictation, listening, writing, speaking, and exam-style Past Questions — plus a 10-question placement quiz that sets your level.
50 original stories with 300 questions, 5 Words of the Day at your level with 10 practice questions, and friend races on an invite link — nothing is locked, and progress is never faked.
Daily streaks with spaced-repetition review, FR↔EN language tools, and a personal diary notebook that never feeds the review queue.
title: Franco

description: Full-stack journaling app for daily work entries, with secure authentication.
highlights: Built and deployed a full-stack developer productivity platform enabling users to log daily work entries (tasks, blockers, learnings) stored as date-indexed MongoDB documents.
Implemented JWT-based authentication with bcrypt password hashing to secure REST API routes, and configured CORS for cross-origin deployment.
Deployed frontend on Vercel and backend on Render with environment-based API configuration
title: DevFlow

description: Digital networking cards with shareable profiles, QR codes, and downloadable PDF resumes.
highlights: Built a digital networking card platform that generates shareable profile cards, QR codes, and downloadable PDF resumes from a single user profile form.
Integrated Puppeteer on the Node.js backend to dynamically render and export server-side PDF resumes from HTML templates.
Designed a decoupled client/server architecture using Axios-based REST API communication between the React frontend and Express backend
title: QuickCard

description: Online store backend and web app with product filtering and image uploads.
highlights: Developed a server-side e-commerce application with RESTful API endpoints supporting product browsing, category and date-based filtering, and new item creation
Integrated Multer and Cloudinary for multipart image uploads, enabling cloud-hosted product images without local storage dependency
Applied JSON-based persistence to manage product and category data, implementing routing and middleware patterns without a database dependency
title: Web E-Commerce Application

description: Retail sales analytics dashboard with interactive filters and visualizations.
highlights: Built an interactive sales analytics dashboard processing a ~10,000-row retail dataset with CSV/XLSX upload support and automatic schema detection for zero-configuration exploration.
Implemented dynamic filters (region, category, date range) driving KPI cards, monthly sales trends, regional profit comparisons, and top-product rankings.
Modularized data-processing logic into a reusable analysis.py module enabling independent chart generation outside the live dashboard.
title: Superstore Dashboard
